name: unexpected_message
condition: A frame not legal for the current state (state-machine total default): out-of-order, wrong-flight, repeated, an application frame before ESTABLISHED, or an effecting frame in ESTABLISHED_READONLY.

name: decrypt_failed
condition: An AEAD open failed, or a handshake CertVerify signature or Finished MAC verification failed.

name: replay_detected
condition: A frame's sequence number was below the replay window or already recorded within it; the frame is dropped and counted, the connection survives.

name: unknown_channel
condition: A frame arrived on a channel the peer did not advertise during the handshake; the frame is dropped and counted.

name: unknown_critical_tlv
condition: A frame carried an unknown extension TLV with the high bit (0x8000) set.

name: handshake_timeout
condition: The handshake did not complete within the handshake-completion timer.

name: downgrade_detected
condition: A profile or algorithm selection was not covered by the transcript the handshake MAC and CertVerify authenticate.

name: close_incomplete
condition: A CLOSE was not acknowledged within the CLOSE_ACK-wait timer.

name: key_update_out_of_order
condition: A KeyUpdateMarker announced an epoch other than current + 1, or was malformed.

name: flow_control_error
condition: A peer's cumulative sent-payload total exceeded the connection-level receive limit advertised via FLOW_UPDATE (Connection-Level Flow Control).

name: (reserved)
condition: Unassigned; reserved to this specification for future core conditions (RFC Required / FCFS for any IANA-hosted mirror; assigned at publication).
